from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

import llm_router._internal.providers.qwenchat
from llm_router import Model, Provider, ProviderError
from llm_router._internal.capabilities.content import normalize_content
from llm_router._internal.providers.base import (
    ProviderCredential,
    ProviderRequest,
    transport_failure,
)
from llm_router._internal.providers.qwenchat import QwenChatAdapter

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_QWENCHAT_ADAPTER_BOUNDARY[revision==1]")
def test_qwenchat_execute_translates_transport_failure(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    value = "neutral-value"
    request = ProviderRequest(
        provider=Provider.QWENCHAT,
        model=Model.QWENCHAT,
        provider_model="qwenchat",
        messages=[normalize_content("test message")],
        credential=ProviderCredential(value),
    )
    adapter = QwenChatAdapter(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8000/api")

    transport_error = (
        llm_router._internal.providers.qwenchat.httpx.ConnectError(
            "Connection refused"
        )
    )

    def _mock_post(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> object:
        raise transport_error

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        llm_router._internal.providers.qwenchat.httpx.Client,
        "post",
        _mock_post,
    )

    with pytest.raises(ProviderError) as exc_info:
        adapter.execute(request)

    expected_failure = transport_failure(request=request, exc=transport_error)
    failure_val = getattr(
        exc_info.value,
        "failure",
        getattr(exc_info.value, "classification", None),
    )
    assert failure_val in (
        expected_failure,
        getattr(expected_failure, "classification", expected_failure),
    )
    assert exc_info.value.provider == request.provider
    assert exc_info.value.model == request.model
    assert exc_info.value.__cause__ is transport_error
